value.rationale: The Ritt resolvent constant is a natural quantitative invariant used in discrete operator analyticity. Its exact value for the canonical Jordan-contraction interpolation has a mathematically meaningful bifurcation of maximizing boundary points, an explicit square-root angle splitting and noncontinuity at the identity in operator norm, all invisible from Rittness or coarse resolvent estimates.
